version_note: v2 (29 Oct): patch centre from a simulated detector on the full noisy field (detector block); v1 = light centre + N(0, 0.7 px), see WORKLOG step 6
note: Step 5 dataset generator (src/generator.py). Instrument values: configs/step3.json (camera) and configs/step4.json (motion). Each parameter group draws EITHER this instrument's measured values (p_instrument) OR the wide training ranges of guide 4.4, independently per group. Units: 'lin' = 8-bit-equivalent linear DN (= Y DN below 19 DN for this camera).

patch.psf_radius_note: kernel radius = clip(ceil(4 x widest Gaussian-eq sigma (+ r0 for a ring)), 12, 30) px
patch.detector_sigma_note: v2: used only in the check modes (zero_error / noise_free)
patch.note: patch centre pixel = floor(light centre + N(0, detector_sigma)); label = true mid-time position - (16.5, 16.5), corner coords (CONVENTIONS)

splits.note: time fractions of each development run; no gyro window shared between splits; 20 Oct cut at minute 75 (hand-held after)

detector.note: cedar-like: Gaussian smoothing, threshold = threshold_sigma x std of the smoothed empty field, blob COM of the light; the target's blob = nearest COM within assoc_px (or the blob over the target's light centre); a neighbour with flux >= owner_flux_ratio x target whose light centre is closer to the detection owns the patch (sample redrawn)

flux.snr_definition: CONVENTIONS: F = SNR * sigma_pix * sqrt(2 pi) * s_eff, sigma_pix = background noise std (lin), s_eff = geometric mean of the per-axis Gaussian-equivalent (same FWHM) sigma

instrument.source: configs/step3.json psf.cells_p10_p50_p90 by ring and flux; quantile interpolation per parameter

random.note: on x = lin / 255: rational y = x (1 + c) / (1 + c x) (gamma-like, faint slope 1 + c); s_curve y = 0.5 (1 + tanh(k (x - 0.5)) / tanh(k / 2))

background.instrument: configs/step3.json background.per_night_per_ring (mu, sigma, s), kernel a, b; c1 by radius from var_vs_level_per_ring
background.noise_note: linear units: bg = mu + sigma * (exp(s z1) - m) / d; star shot noise sqrt(c1 * S) * z2; z1, z2 independent fields with the same correlation kernel [b, a, 1, a, b] (separable, unit variance)

neighbours.note: Poisson number, uniform positions over the padded field; same PSF and motion as the target (the path change over 20 px is < 0.05 px)

artefacts.note: flagged in the params (bad = 1); the label stays the target star

motion.instrument: configs/step4.json (real intervals, gyro errors, readout 10-35 ms vs nominal 18 ms, vibration 0-0.5 px)

channel1.background_estimate: median of the outer 3-pixel frame of the patch
channel1.noise_scale: std of an empty synthetic 64 x 64 patch with the same background, tone, bit depth (the 'whole-frame' sigma measured on empty sky)

not_in_v1: Bayer / mono and star colour (no frame-position input: a colour shift is label noise)
vignetting (changes only the SNR, which is drawn directly)
noise reduction that erases faint stars
